messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Dedicated pool eu-west-2a — tenant=sylvan.ai — sustained high p95 latency (>=1.6s) and ~3% dropped requests over last 5m. Auto-escalation to oncall team.
matt (oncall): oncall here. thanks bot. sylvan is on a dedicated reserved pool, right? any customer-facing alerts?
lyla (customer-success): sylvan-ops confirmed customer is seeing timeouts for interactive chat flows, major customers impacted (payments path). they're noticing errors spike during longer-context prompts.
sam (eng-runtime): looking at metrics now — queue depth and batch size distribution look abnormal. mean batch_tokens for sylvan jumped from ~400 to ~1800 in last 10m. scheduler backlog rising.
sam (eng-runtime): quick snippets:
```
tenant=sylvan.ai
p95_latency=1.82s -> now
error_rate=3.1% (5m)
avg_batch_tokens=1460
queue_depth=28
cpu/gpu utilization ~ 72% but burst queuing causing tail latency
```
jordan (sre): thanks. that batch token spike explains the long KV cache handling and GPU kernel thrash. immediate mitigations: 1) reduce max_batch_tokens for this tenant 2) apply bespoke queue shaping 3) if needed, isolate tenant into a silenced queue with lower concurrency.
matt (oncall): agree. sam, can you push a temporary override for sylvan: max_batch_tokens -> 512 and scheduler_weight -> 0.6? also reduce max_concurrent_requests to 12 for tenant to avoid head-of-line. put it as a canary 2/10 hosts first.
sam (eng-runtime): preparing override. deploying via ops API — will canary to two hosts in eu-west-2a. curl command I'm using: 
```
curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/tenants/sylvan/overrides -d '{"overrides": {"max_batch_tokens": 512, "max_concurrent_requests": 12, "scheduler_weight": 0.6}, "canary_hosts": 2}'
```
sam (eng-runtime): pushing now. will post logs and canary ids.
incident-bot: deploy started: canary_id=canary-9932 hosts=2 target_pool=eu-west-2a
sam (eng-runtime): canary applied to host ids [i-0a12, i-0a13]. watching metrics.
sam (eng-runtime): 60s after canary: host i-0a12 p95=430ms, i-0a13 p95=410ms for sylvan traffic. overall pool p95 still 1.1s because rest of hosts unmodified. error rate on canary hosts dropped to 0.4%.
jordan (sre): good signal. recommend rolling the override to all sylvan-assigned hosts in the pool gradually (5 -> 50 -> 100). also we should lower tenant burst_limit to 150 for now.
matt (oncall): do the gradual roll. add a routing rule to route new requests to canary hosts for 30s after roll to avoid spikes.
sam (eng-runtime): rolling to 50% now. applying additional override burst_limit=150. API call logged: roll_job=roll-7712.
sam (eng-runtime): metrics at 50%: global p95 for sylvan down to 360ms, global error rate 0.6%, queue_depth down to 6.
lyla (customer-success): passing update to sylvan-ops: they see improvements on their side, timeouts dropping. some customers still hit old servers for long requests but trend is positive.
jordan (sre): leaving note for post-incident: run a short eval on long-context prompts to detect output regressions from reduced batching. Add to incident ticket.
matt (oncall): good. timeline so far + write-up:
- 1937654321: incident-bot paging oncall
- 1937654340: initial triage, decided mitigate via per-tenant overrides
- 1937654362: canary overrides applied to 2 hosts
- 1937654420: canary shows p95 -> ~420ms, error rate down
- 1937654498: rolled to 50% hosts
- 1937654589: global p95 ~360ms, error rate ~0.6%
Action items:
1) sam: finish 100% rollout and monitor for 15m
2) jordan: create postmortem section on scheduler knobs and propose permanent QoS for dedicated tenants
3) lyla: coordinate with sylvan-ops to confirm resolution with customers and share status page notes
4) oncall: if we see recurrence, consider isolating sylvan into a siloed queue with dedicated concurrency limits and separate autoscaler.
sam (eng-runtime): 100% rollout complete at 1937655210. monitoring continuing.
maria (day-oncall): pinged — taking handoff now. current state: overrides active, metrics stable last 10m: p95=340ms, error_rate=0.25%, queue_depth<=5.
matt (oncall): handing over to maria. if anything spikes back up, escalate to eng-runtime and SRE.
maria (day-oncall): ack. I've got runbook link and will coordinate follow-ups. runbook: https://playbooks.internal/runbooks/tenant-bespoke-batching
incident-bot: incident resolved condition met: sustained p95 < 500ms and error_rate < 1% for 10m. auto-close scheduled in 30m unless reopened. :white_check_mark:
